publication.body:
## 범위
- 두 차례(2026-10-19)의 VigilODE 벤치마크를 재현 가능한 최소 형태로 게시합니다.
- 첫 번째 **154행 endpoint CSV**, 두 번째 **2,700행 CT CSV**는 원본 바이트를 그대로 보존했습니다. Git blob SHA까지 업로드 전후 일치 확인했습니다.
- 각 실행의 측정 commit 및 Rust·호스트 조건, 정상/거부/실패와 정확도 기준, claim boundary를 README와 별도 REPORT_KO.md에 기록했습니다.
- Python stdlib 검증기 `verify_csv.py`를 추가했고 실제 CSV에서 통과했습니다.

## Git identity
- PR base: `claude/nice-dijkstra-208xq0` (분기 당시 `a21d573980f66fe02891bd216153443b5352f921`)
- Run1 measured: `ccaeaa50beb4580505a36d25ccb919ec3ca38c7f`
- Run2 measured Rust: `8a8bd409b1d96c7b7421f496d229e119fd3d284e`

## 검증
- `python3 research/benchmark_results_20261019/verify_csv.py` (PASS_SCOPED_CSV_INTEGRITY)
- remote Git blobs matched exact local CSV bytes and tested verifier source.
- compare from base: 6 added files in research/benchmark_results_20261019 only, no solver sources altered.

## Evidence limits
- Earlier detailed reports, plot PNGs, full profiler/paired-timing receipts and a ~184MB reproducible bundle were not mounted in this turn; not pushed.
- Corresponding historical timing / allocation / Ir conclusions in Run2 report are explicitly tagged `PRIOR_REPORT_ONLY`, not newly checked.
- Shared-VM timing is diagnostic and neither report authorizes full component promotion or a continuous-time error guarantee.

This is a **draft documentation/evidence PR**; numerical code and historical FAIL records remain untouched.
